metadata.name: AviationEmergencyLandingOntology
metadata.description: A structured representation of aviation emergency landing procedures, conditions, and pilot actions to assist in decision-making during emergencies.

classes.name: EmergencyLanding
classes.description: A landing performed under emergency conditions, often involving risks to the aircraft and occupants.

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: A detailed description of the emergency landing scenario.

attributes.name: landing_outcome
attributes.description: The outcome of the emergency landing (e.g., successful, crash).

classes.name: PilotAction
classes.description: Actions taken by the pilot during emergency situations to ensure safety.

attributes.name: pilot_experience
attributes.description: The level of experience of the pilot performing the action.

classes.name: EmergencyLandingSite
classes.description: A location chosen by the pilot for landing the aircraft in an emergency situation.

classes.name: Hazard
classes.description: A condition that poses a risk to the safety of the aircraft and its occupants.

attributes.name: risk_level
attributes.description: The level of risk associated with a specific hazard.

classes.name: AircraftState
classes.description: The condition of the aircraft during flight, particularly in emergencies.

attributes.name: aircraft_condition
attributes.description: The condition of the aircraft at the time of the emergency.

classes.name: Terrain
classes.description: The physical landscape or ground surface that can affect the safety and feasibility of an emergency landing.

attributes.name: terrain_type
attributes.description: The type of terrain (e.g., forest, water, snow) relevant to emergency landings.

classes.name: PsychologicalHazard
classes.description: Factors that may interfere with a pilot's ability to act promptly and properly during an emergency.

attributes.name: psychological_impact
attributes.description: The impact of psychological factors on pilot performance.

classes.name: Procedure
classes.description: A set of actions or steps to be followed in a specific situation, particularly during emergencies.

attributes.name: procedure_steps
attributes.description: The steps involved in executing a specific emergency procedure.

object_properties.name: requires
object_properties.description: Indicates that a specific pilot action is necessary for a given emergency landing.

object_properties.name: governed_by
object_properties.description: Indicates that the selection of an emergency landing site is influenced by terrain characteristics.

object_properties.name: affects
object_properties.description: Indicates that the current state of the aircraft influences the pilot's actions.

object_properties.name: is_suitable_for
object_properties.description: Indicates that a specific type of terrain is suitable for a particular emergency landing.

object_properties.name: has_procedure
object_properties.description: Links an emergency landing to the specific procedures that should be followed.

object_properties.name: indicates
object_properties.description: Indicates that a hazard affects the state of the aircraft.

object_properties.name: impairs
object_properties.description: Indicates that a psychological hazard can impair a pilot's actions.

object_properties.name: results_in
object_properties.description: Indicates that a specific pilot action leads to an emergency landing.

validation_rules.rule: An emergency landing must have a description and associated procedures.
Pilot actions must be linked to specific emergency scenarios.
Hazards must have a defined risk level.
